title: Outlook repeatedly prompts for password without accepting it
symptoms: Outlook desktop app loops asking for credentials even though the same password works on webmail
resolution:
1. Remove and re-add the account profile in Outlook
2. Update Outlook to the latest version
3. Clear saved/cached credentials for Outlook in the device's credential manager

title: Mailbox storage full, unable to send or receive mail
symptoms: Bounce-back messages or 'mailbox full' warnings when sending; new mail fails to arrive
resolution:
1. Empty Deleted Items and Junk folders to free up space immediately
2. Archive or delete large attachments from older emails
3. Request a mailbox quota increase if usage is legitimately high

title: Legitimate emails going to Junk/Spam folder
symptoms: Expected emails from known senders consistently land in Junk instead of Inbox
resolution:
1. Add the sender's address to the Safe Senders list
2. Review and adjust junk email filter sensitivity settings
3. Report the specific email as 'Not Junk' to help retrain the filter

title: Old emails missing after account merge or migration
symptoms: Mailbox shows only recent emails; historical mail from before a migration/merge event is gone
resolution:
1. Allow 24-48 hours for full re-indexing after any migration or merge event
2. Check both webmail and desktop client, as sync timing can differ between them
3. Request a mailbox migration status check if mail is still missing after 48 hours

title: Unable to send emails to external (non-VIT) addresses
symptoms: Emails to external domains bounce or fail, while internal VIT-to-VIT emails send normally
resolution:
1. Check the specific bounce-back message for an external mail relay restriction
2. Confirm the account isn't flagged for restricted outbound relay (common for new/contractual accounts)
3. Request outbound relay permission review if restriction is confirmed

title: Mail not syncing on mobile device
symptoms: New emails appear on webmail/desktop but not on the mobile Outlook or native mail app
resolution:
1. Remove and re-add the email account on the mobile device
2. Confirm mobile app has background sync/refresh permission enabled
3. Check for an expired app password if using a legacy mail client requiring one

title: Shared/departmental mailbox not accessible
symptoms: User with prior access to a shared mailbox suddenly cannot open or send-as from it
resolution:
1. Confirm shared mailbox permissions haven't been modified or removed on the backend
2. Remove and re-add the shared mailbox in Outlook to refresh the connection
3. Re-request delegate/send-as access if permissions were confirmed removed

title: Auto-forwarding or rules not working as configured
symptoms: Email rules set up by the user (forwarding, categorizing) silently stop functioning
resolution:
1. Verify the rule wasn't disabled by a security policy blocking auto-forward to external addresses
2. Recreate the rule from scratch, as corrupted rules can silently fail
3. Check rule order/conflicts if multiple rules exist for overlapping conditions
